title: NetworkMachineOnlinePayload
description: network.machine.online v1 (OpenVibe.Network, plan L34: the machines hub). A machine of a person (a Bot device of kind machine) came online: it checked in and is connected to Bot. Network republishes Bot's change (Bot reports it to Network, which writes this event), so a consumer of the network's events hears about a machine once, in one place. Envelope: subject { type: machine, id: <dev_…> }, visibility internal, actor service:network.

principal_id.description: The machine's node principal on Network, when it has one.

owner.description: The person the machine belongs to.
